num_filters.notes: Active optical passbands (zg, zr, zi) with >= 1 observation

time_baseline_days.notes: Span between first and last clean photometric observation

window_duration_days.notes: Duration of candidate transient outburst evaluation window

peak_normalized_flux.notes: Maximum normalized flux observed in sequence

minimum_normalized_flux.notes: Minimum normalized flux observed in sequence

rise_time_proxy_days.notes: Half-maximum rise duration proxy to peak observation

decline_time_proxy_days.notes: Half-maximum decline duration proxy from peak observation

event_characterization.classification_disclaimer: No astrophysical classification claimed from non-learned features alone.

limitations: Evaluated on 106-object Real-ZTF Primary Benchmark (AUROC = 0.6881, AUPRC = 0.6862, FPR = 5.17%).
Operates directly on 128-D light-curve representations extracted by frozen LightCurveEncoder.
Decision threshold calibrated at 95th percentile of known in-distribution real ZTF transients.
Does not claim uncalibrated astrophysical discovery; requires multi-wavelength or spectroscopic confirmation.
anomaly_assessment.domain_gap_notes: Evaluated research model operating on real ZTF 128-D light-curve representation space. Image modality mismatch resolved by light-curve-only regularized distance scoring.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Type Ia Supernova (Thermonuclear)
contradictory_evidence: Exact rest-frame Si II 6355 A absorption unmeasured
candidate_hypotheses.justification: Observed rise proxy (3.0d) and asymmetric decline conform to canonical Ni-56 powered thermonuclear transients.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: Phase-matched template fitting to B/V band light curves or optical spectrum at maximum light.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Core-Collapse Supernova (Type II)
contradictory_evidence: Plateau duration and hydrogen envelope signatures require multi-band color monitoring
candidate_hypotheses.justification: Optical rise and decline compatible with stripped-envelope or plateau core-collapse events.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: Low-resolution optical spectroscopy confirming P-Cygni H-alpha absorption/emission.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Unclassified Transient / Variable
contradictory_evidence: Single outburst recorded in evaluation interval
candidate_hypotheses.justification: Transient duration broadly consistent with expanding supernova ejecta or long-period variable.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: Target-of-opportunity optical spectroscopy to identify line features and host redshift.

recommended_observations.scientific_rationale: Disambiguate competing scientific hypotheses ('Type Ia Supernova (Thermonuclear)') via spectral line identification and redshift determination.
recommended_observations.information_gap: Zero spectroscopic observations available; physical expansion velocities and composition unconstrained

recommended_observations.scientific_rationale: Constrain radioactive decay tail slope (Co-56 vs circumstellar interaction) or confirm quiescent return.
recommended_observations.information_gap: Post-peak light curve decline rate unconstrained at late epochs

limitations: Anomaly scores are suppressed: multimodal ensemble was trained on synthetic data with co-temporal difference images.
Real ZTF input is processed through the Light-Curve-First pathway without image-modality fusion.
Hypotheses reflect physical heuristics and retrieved literature, not automated ML classification.
Redshift, host galaxy associations, and absolute luminosities are unconstrained without external catalog queries.
Production checkpoint remained strictly frozen (no retraining, no fine-tuning, no threshold alteration).
